title: Open the reviewed source directly in VS Code
summary: Start at the URI handler, follow the safe repository handoff, then inspect the exact file-and-caret reveal that replaces language-provider navigation. The final stops pin validation, workspace restart recovery, and the silent direct-source behavior.

intent.goal: Let a DiffStory click open the reviewed file at the clicked location without a misleading implementation-or-definition notification.
intent.design: The bridge validates the repository-bound URI, opens and resumes the reviewed workspace when necessary, then terminates at one clamped source caret and explicitly reveals it in the editor.
nonGoals: Deliberately does not ask VS Code language providers for implementations or definitions; this interaction now means open this reviewed source location.

hotspots.reason: The installed files and focused tests are verified, but VS Code denied the automated window reload needed to visually exercise version 0.9.2 in the already-running extension host.

storyScope.reviewerNote: Review the authored extension path and focused tests here. Documentation, package metadata, generated JavaScript, source maps, and the packaged VSIX are excluded from this code story.

steps.title: URI activation owns the complete navigation lifecycle
steps.why: Start here: one URI request now validates, prepares its workspace, and either opens immediately or resumes after VS Code switches folders.

beats.text: Start here: the registered URI handler rejects malformed locations before any workspace or editor state can move.
The handler delegates missing-workspace recovery before navigation, so the direct file jump receives the correct repository context even after an extension-host restart.
Startup and workspace-change hooks close the restart gap, ensuring a saved click is not lost while the reviewed repository opens.

steps.title: Navigation requests carry explicit repository identity
steps.why: The entry point hands its query here; repository identity and explicit host operations make the restart-prone workspace transition testable instead of implicit.

beats.text: The request carries both repository and file identity, so opening a workspace is based on explicit review context instead of guessing from the active window.
The preparation host names containment, persistence, and folder opening as separate effects, exposing the ordering that must survive a VS Code reload.

steps.title: Parsed source paths stay inside the reviewed repository
steps.why: With the request shape established, absolute paths, bounded coordinates, and normalized containment prevent auto-open from escaping the reviewed tree.

beats.text: The parser requires repository, source, and bounded coordinates before any workspace operation can begin.
Containment is checked after normalization, preventing a crafted sibling or parent path from turning a review click into an unrelated local file open.

steps.title: Workspace switching persists the click before VS Code reloads
steps.why: Once the request is trusted, this seam distinguishes an immediate source open from the restart-prone repository-opening path.

beats.text: The ready path stays immediate, while the missing-workspace path records the request before opening the folder so a host restart cannot erase the clicked location.

steps.title: Pending navigation has one bounded global-state contract
steps.why: The preparation seam stores one typed request with a five-minute lifetime, giving restart recovery enough state without leaving stale clicks indefinitely.

beats.text: The extension imports the pure validation, preparation, and caret helpers as the only navigation decisions outside VS Code APIs.
One global-state key and timestamp make the workspace handoff resumable while bounding how long an abandoned click can survive.

steps.title: Resume waits for the reviewed folder and consumes the request once
steps.why: With pending state defined, repository validation and one-time consumption ensure the click resumes only inside an available Git workspace.

beats.text: Before switching folders, the extension verifies both the directory and its Git marker, so an invalid review URI cannot replace the active workspace.
After activation, the request waits until its source belongs to the loaded workspace, then clears before opening so repeated startup events cannot replay it.

steps.title: The navigation terminates at the reviewed file and caret
steps.why: This is the behavior the user asked for: open the source, select the clicked coordinate, reveal it, and show UI only when opening actually fails.

beats.text: The resumed request opens its exact reviewed file and converts the incoming location into a valid editor position.
The source editor receives that zero-width selection and explicitly reveals it, so the clicked line is brought into view without a language-provider detour.
Only a real source-opening failure now produces a notification; a successful direct jump stays silent.

steps.title: Stale coordinates resolve to the nearest visible caret
steps.why: The direct-source step delegates coordinate conversion here so a changed file cannot turn an otherwise valid click into an out-of-range editor error.

beats.text: The helper converts one-based review coordinates to VS Code positions and clamps both axes, preserving the nearest useful location when the file moved after the review rendered.

steps.title: Parser tests reject path escape and invalid coordinates
steps.why: The first proof block pins the request boundary before the tests move on to workspace side effects.

beats.text: The valid fixture proves repository identity survives URL encoding alongside the exact source coordinate.
The rejection matrix guards relative, malformed, sibling, and prefix-confusion paths, keeping automatic folder opening inside its intended boundary.

steps.title: Workspace tests pin persist-before-open ordering
steps.why: The second proof block makes the restart-sensitive ordering observable and confirms the already-open path has no persistence side effects.

beats.text: The missing-workspace fixture records the exact call order, so opening before persistence would fail this regression immediately.
The ready-workspace fixture proves normal clicks bypass both persistence and folder opening, preserving the fast direct path.

steps.title: Final proof removes provider lookup and the noisy toast
steps.why: Final proof pins both coordinate clamping and the built extension contract the screenshot exposed.

beats.text: The caret fixture covers both an exact location and a stale request beyond the current document, guarding the visible scroll target.
The built-artifact assertions require explicit reveal behavior while banning both provider commands and the old success toast, so the simpler interaction cannot quietly regress.
